gameDescriptionHtml:
“Sensei! I Like You So Much!” is a fandom business simulation game. You will play as a fanfic author, create & release your fanzine, join comicons, gather followers, and become a legend with your fellow fans around! You can buy goods of your pairing, build itabags, and decorate your room as well!

Game Features

  • CUSTOMIZE CHARACTERS – As a fangirl, you can freely set up your blorbo. The game features highly customizable character creation, allowing you to manually recreate your blorbo in every possible way! New desktop pet companion mode added – your oshi can not only move freely and interact within the game, but can also become a desktop pet to accompany you during work & study. Version 1.0 adds more destinations and collectible content such as the theater, amusement park, merchandise store, tea partie, etc. Spread your love for your blorbo to every corner of the world!
  • BUILD SEASIDE ATELIER – Version 1.0 BRAND NEW FEATURE! You can build a “Seaside Atelier” in the game. Manufacture materials like tin sheets, paper, glass, etc., to create limited merchandise that belong only to you! The higher the floors, the more content you can unlock – desktop pet, shelf arrangement, city roaming… From foundation to skyline, build up your own cyber treasure pavilion!
  • GACHA & WIN YOUR MERCH – Version 1.0 adds a gacha machine simulator! Operate the joystick and become a cyber lucky emperor. Gacha features various exclusive gacha items from common to SSR rarity, plus ultimate easter eggs – it’s time to prove your luck with skill! You can also purchase other randomly dropped rare items in the secondhand market! Version 1.0 adds many interactive collectibles including holographic ticket stubs, holographic badges, acrylics, vinyl records, cassette tapes, and other rare collectible figures & ita-bags for collection. Collect more ita-bags, badge holders, and wrapping papers to decorate your own luxurious ita-room, as long as your lovely ita-bag!
  • HANDCRAFT & PRINT – Create your own freebie at the crafting station! Unlock stickers and illusts, increase your hand-crafting level and unleash your imagination! Showcase your freebies on your wall or ita-bag, or upload them to the Creative Workshop to share with fellow fans at conventions! You can also enter “friend codes” to receive goods made by friends, achieving true cyber freebie exchange! In version 1.0, the game opens pattern download function! All merchandise obtained and freebies made in the game can be printed out to accompany you in the real world!
  • CREATE YOUR STORIES – Go outdoors to gather inspiration, then return home and transform your newfound insights into captivating stories. Take control of the narrative’s direction by selecting pivotal plot branches that lead to your desired endings. Use Steam Workshop to add your own customized stories! In order to captivate your readers and expand your fan base, it’s also important to grasp popular trends. Fulfill commissioned requests and gather inspiration across diverse categories! In version 1.0, you can customize your own fanzine, and share them at online conventions for other players to see. You can also visit other players’ booths to collect and appreciate their carefully-crafted zines!
  • PLAY WITH DESKTOP PETS – A newly-added gaming system called “Tamigotchi” comes with version 1.0! You can freely raise your blorbo in a nostalgic handheld game device. Feed, play, work, idle, travel, AND multiple mini-games for slacking off… Tamigotchi can also float on your desktop, accompanying your studying & working!
  • MEET MORE FELLOW FANS – During your time in the fandom, you will meet four distinct fellow fans. Your unwavering companion in the niche corners of fandom. The encouraging event organizer in love with your work. The enigmatic and influential goddess writer. And… your seemingly-aggresive anti-fan. Version 1.0 adds three new emotional intimacy characters: a legendary mysterious big-name creator who has been a fanwoman for 40 years (a.k.a. your grandmother), a handicraft enthusiast and god-tier artist who always supports protagonists, and a theater lover and god-tier writer who always supports supporting characters. United by a shared passion, together you will embark on a journey of camaraderie and shared experiences within the vibrant fan culture community!
  • ATTEND COMIC-CON EVENT – The last boss is finally here! Culminate your passion in self-published fanzines and prepare for the comic convention! Time to set up your booth as a vendor. Choose your fanzines, merch and decoration. Sell fanzines with speed & precision! Planning your route and zero in on popular booths – race with time as a customer! Will you get what you want? On the grand year-end Comic-Con event “CT30”, unveil your creations, connect with fellow fans, and share your passion with the world!
